name: Clean
long_description:
Agents can run outreach on their own now.

In manufacturing, insurance, defense and banking, buying runs on a clock. Every deal has a transaction window almost nobody can see. Reach out before it opens and nobody answers. After it closes, the deal's gone.

Clean finds that window and gives agents and sales teams the strategy to win the deal.

We're building the revenue intelligence every sales agent will run on.

launches.title: Clean: Revenue intelligence for agents and sales teams
launches.tagline: We predict B2B transactions before they happen, and give sellers the account and the strategy to close them.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Clean tracks thousands of signals across the companies you sell to and predicts B2B transactions before they happen. Your sales team and your agents get the account and the strategy to close each one. Try it at [tryclean.ai](https://tryclean.ai).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qZO3QrW57os>

**Timing decides the deal**

In regulated industries like manufacturing, insurance and defense, and in tech infrastructure, a buyer can only switch in a short window, and after that they're locked in for years. Every sales team has a list of who fits. What it doesn't have is when.

And now everyone's building sales agents that work the same lists and send the same emails, so knowing when matters more every month.

**A real example**

SPM (YC F26) makes custom battery packs. A company they wanted to sell to was a hybrid-electric aircraft maker. Over two months, Clean picked up:

\- Week 0: they announce a new plant

\- Week 1: they sign their engine supplier

\- Week 8: they fly their first demo flight

Alone, none of that means much. Together, it means the plane is real, the engine is decided and the battery is the next thing they buy. Clean flagged the account and the person who picks suppliers. He replied to SPM in 15 minutes. They'd signed a battery supplier that same week, and he still wanted to hear more.

That's how small the window is.

**How it works**

1\. Learns your business from your docs and website.

2\. Tracks thousands of signals: filings, press releases, spec sheets, hiring posts and more, lined up per company as they happen.

3\. Predicts the transaction: which deals are coming, who decides and how to approach them. Every signal is sourced.

4\. Lives where you work:

* Slack
* Claude, Codex and your other AI tools
* Your CRM
* Our app
* Our API and MCP for your own agents

You can send the outreach and track the whole customer lifecycle through Clean.

**More than leads**

Timing is where we started. The same picture shows which customers are ready to expand and which accounts are at risk. Customers also use it to learn their own market: SPM and Hyperspell (YC F25) both changed who they sell to because of what Clean showed them.

**Results**

\- SPM's buyer replied in 15 minutes

\- On SPM's best campaign, 21 of the 47 buyers who connected wrote back

\- Hyperspell got on a call with a kind of company it hadn't been selling to, and now goes after more like it

**Team**

We're four technical, sales-heavy founders. Pavan is a 2x founder who was closing enterprise deals at Cisco straight out of high school, then led growth at a seed-stage startup to $300K+ in revenue and 28M views in six months. Clarissa won the International Physics Olympiad, then turned down a quant offer from Citadel to build Clean. Pratham is a top open-source builder whose app has 10K+ users, and did AI research backed by India's richest person, alongside IIT researchers. Tejas is an operator who previously scaled a startup to $40M, and 2x time as well.

**Our ask**

If you sell B2B, especially into manufacturing, insurance, fintech, legal or infrastructure, book a demo at [tryclean.ai](http://tryclean.ai) or email [yc@tryclean.ai](mailto:yc@tryclean.ai). If you're building sales agents and want them to know when to reach out, we'd love to talk.
